input.quote: 7.6 Vendor warrants that Fees charged to Customer will be no less favourable than fees offered to any similarly situated customer for comparable volumes and terms.
input.rationale: The only MFN-type provision in the Agreement is § 7.6, which runs in our favour: Vendor warrants that Fees charged to Customer will be no less favourable than fees offered to any similarly situated customer for comparable volumes and terms. We searched the Fees (§ 7), Order Forms (§ 4), and General (§ 30) sections and the full document for MFN, best-pricing, matching, or "no less favourable" language and found no obligation requiring Customer to extend Vendor terms given to third parties or to match third-party offers. This meets the preferred position (no MFN obligation burdening Customer), and the Vendor-granted MFN is a benefit we retain, so no redline is proposed.

mappings.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.
